chunks: From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked him about the owned slave: may he lead the people in prayer? He said: No, unless he is the most learned of them in fiqh and the most knowledgeable of them.

key_terms.أَفْقَهَهُمْ: the most learned among them in fiqh
key_terms.يَؤُمُّ: leads as Imam in congregational salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Can a slave lead the people in congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about whether an owned slave may lead people in salat (prayer). It states that he should not do so unless he surpasses them in fiqh and knowledge, indicating the priority of religious learning and qualification in leadership of congregational prayer.
